name: NH Collection Roma Giustiniano
description: NH Collection Roma Giustiniano is a hidden oasis in the heart of bustling Rome. Situated right beside the River Tiber and close to all that the city has to offer including St Peter's Basilica, Sant'Angelo Bridge, Sant'Angelo Castle and the Trastevere neighborhood. Luxurious designer boutiques and fine dining are only steps away. Marvel at the wonders of Vatican City which is found within walking distance. If you are driving, there is an on-site garage. NH Collection Roma Giustiniano has 161 rooms, all finished in a modern, minimalist style and featuring hardwood floors. Some of the rooms look out over the historic landmarks of Rome. Enjoy a fragrant Italian espresso with a Lavazza machine in each room. For relaxation, we have a pillow menu, rain-effect shower and soundproofing, and to stay connected there is free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. For breakfast, you will be delighted with local dishes and a variety of cold and hot plates, including gluten-free options and children's breakfast. Lunch and dinner are served at Zenzero & Cannella, and for a relaxing drink head to the stylish bar. 8 meeting rooms are available at the hotel.
